_doc: Config for the ABV OB In Progress daily rebuild. Prompt text lives in abv_trigger_prompt.md. NOTE: the Monday server is supplied through mcp_connections (connector_uuid e9a2b928-...), NOT through mcp_config — the FY26 trigger's mcp_config carries only the remote-devices bridge, which is not mounted in scheduled sessions. Copying mcp_config verbatim would have shipped a trigger with no Monday access. Verify the echo against invariants[] after every send: resends are documented to drop fields silently.
cron_note: 11:30 UTC = 7:30 AM EDT, 30 min after the FY26 rebuild (0 11) so the two runs never contend for Monday. Weekdays only: the board does not move at weekends. Tommy asked for 'daily' — if he means seven days, change 1-5 to *.
invariants: NEVER judge these accounts against the board's 42-day time-to-value target
